key_decisions.rationale: Keeps something like, the three adversarial objects and the on/beside ambiguity in notes.
key_decisions.before: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire, and people who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
key_decisions.after: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had overcome the beast, its image and the number of its name standing on the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, standing beside the sea of glass, holding harps of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned ages rather than nations or saints and preserves both songs and Moses' status.
key_decisions.before: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations.
key_decisions.after: They sing the song of Moses, God's slave, and the song of the Lamb: “Great and astonishing are your works, Lord God, the Almighty. Righteous and true are your ways, King of the ages.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, O King of the nations.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows linen and preserves both sevens and the sash position.

key_decisions.after: The seven angels with the seven plagues came out of the temple, dressed in clean, shining linen, with golden sashes around their chests.
